title: GB Noodles · Microsites component contract
description: Component contract, version 2 (skill 12.0.0). Four layers: api (framework-neutral API: props, cssStates, events, slots, exclusive, icons, tokens), code (HTML binding: path, classes, example, classByProp, stateAnatomy), figma (traceability: keys, original property names, axes, nested instances, bindings) and docs (where the hand-written criteria live). Generated by ds-sync from the Figma dump; the manual fields (events, slots, exclusive, classByProp, stateAnatomy, example, classes, accessibility, verification, related) are kept across syncs. Every piece of data has one owner.

anatomyHash.description: Fingerprint (12 hex) of the master's anatomy as read from Figma: component key, variant axes, properties, bound tokens and nested children. Written by ds-sync; no dates, so the same master yields the same hash. The verification protocol copies it into verification.figmaVersion.

verification.description: Whether this contract (CSS + .md) has been checked against its Figma master, variant by variant, following guides/verificacion.md. Written by the person or agent who verifies; ds-sync keeps it and flips it to 'stale' when anatomyHash changes or the master disappears. Missing block = unverified.

figmaVersion.description: meta.anatomyHash at the time of verification.

name.description: API name, camelCase, framework-neutral. Never the Figma name (that lives in figma.propertyNames).

figma.description: Original Figma property or axis name (or 'state=<value>' for a boolean derived from the state axis). Traceability only.

props.description: Generated from Figma: component properties (TEXT → string, BOOLEAN → boolean, INSTANCE_SWAP → icon) and variant axes (→ enum; yes/no axes → boolean; the state axis → one boolean per data state, CSS states go to cssStates).

cssStates.description: States that only CSS expresses (hover, press, focus…). Not props. From ds-sync.config.json → cssStates.

events.description: MANUAL. What the component emits and when. e.g. {name: 'change', when: 'the value changes and the component is not disabled'}.

slots.description: MANUAL. Projected content (ng-content, children). e.g. {name: 'default', accepts: 'text or inline elements'}.

exclusive.description: MANUAL. Groups of props that cannot be set together, e.g. [['disabled','loading']]: combinations that do not exist in Figma once the state axis is split into booleans.

icons.description: Explicit icon summary so an agent never misses that a component carries an icon.

unexposedIconLayers.description: Icon instances without an INSTANCE_SWAP property — audit finding.

tokens.description: Figma variable paths bound on the master (was tokensUsed).

classes.description: Copied by ds-sync from the ficha's «Ejemplo de código».

example.description: Copied by ds-sync from the ficha. Its root element carries data-ds="<slug>" (traceability screen → contract → Figma).

classByProp.description: MANUAL. Which class each prop value maps to, e.g. {"type": {"negative": "button--negative"}, "disabled": "button--disabled"}. Filled when the contract is verified against its master.

stateAnatomy.description: Manual (kept by ds-sync). Cases where a state changes the component's STRUCTURE, not only its style, so a screen can carry valid classes and still be incomplete. Filled by whoever verifies the contract against its Figma master (guides/verificacion.md). Checked in UI/ screens by scripts/ds-fidelity.py (screen-state-anatomy).

when.description: Minimal selector that locates the case in a screen: compound classes (.a.b), optional tag (span.a) and descendant combinator (space). Nothing else.

require.description: Selectors that must exist INSIDE the element matched by `when`.

why.description: The sentence a person reads in the warning.

propertyNames.description: API prop name → original Figma property or axis name. The map that keeps traceability once the API stops using Figma names.

nestedInstances.description: Every INSTANCE inside the default variant, visible or not. Empty array only if the component contains no instances.

exposedAs.description: Name of the INSTANCE_SWAP property that controls it, or null if not exposed.

toggledBy.description: Name of the BOOLEAN property that shows/hides it, or null.

docs.description: Where the hand-written criteria of this contract live: purpose, accessibility, when to use and what it does not do. They live only there; the schema points, it does not copy.

file.description: Path from the project root to the contract's own file: design-system/docs/components/<slug>.md or design-system/docs/patterns/<slug>.md.

section.description: Exact text of the '### <Nombre>' heading, without the sync date that follows it.

accessibility.description: Cómo percibe y opera este componente quien no lo ve. El contraste AA es condición necesaria y no suficiente: un lector de pantalla no navega por color. Opcional en el schema para no invalidar contratos anteriores, obligatorio en la práctica (política screen-reader-spec).

role.description: Rol semántico: button, textbox, checkbox, dialog, alert, navigation… 'none' si es decorativo.

name.description: De dónde sale el nombre accesible: del texto visible, de una etiqueta asociada o de un atributo explícito. Un icono sin texto SIEMPRE necesita nombre explícito.

announcedStates.description: Qué se anuncia al cambiar de estado: seleccionado, expandido, inválido, ocupado, deshabilitado. Un estado que solo se ve por color no existe para quien no ve.

keyboard.description: Qué teclas lo operan y qué hace cada una. Si no se puede usar sin ratón, no está terminado.

focus.description: Dónde entra el foco, dónde sale y si queda atrapado a propósito (modales).

readingOrder.description: Orden en que se leen sus partes, si no coincide con el visual.

hidden.description: Partes que deben ocultarse al lector por ser decorativas o redundantes.

platforms.description: Equivalencia por plataforma cuando el producto no es solo web.

contrastPairs.description: Pares texto/fondo verificados AA, en los dos modos. Lo que ya se exigía.

relations.description: usedBy is not here any more: relationships.json owns it.

uses.description: Slugs of every component instantiated inside (one per nestedInstances entry, deduplicated). Icons included.

anatomy.description: SOLO CON LA FUENTE EN EL REPO (design-system/source). Capas (árbol), estados e interacciones tal como se diseñaron; puede expresar más de lo que Figma admite. No se edita aquí: lo genera ds-sync desde source/components/<slug>.json.

layers.description: Árbol de capas: layer o slot, type, layout, style, text, instance, props, visibleWhen, children.
